meaning:
Giloh = "exile"
a city in the mountains of Judah, home town of Ahithophel
Also named: gi.lo.ni (גִּילֹנִי "Gilonite" H1526)

elsewhere.note: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong…
